text: Use only the SOLIDS FOR YOU tools (github.com/Founderwithabs/SOLIDSFORYOU), routed by Master. Do not use the old claude.ai skills sfy-reel-virality or quell-reel-virality.
Store facts, decisions and preferences in this memory sheet (memory/memory.csv) and look them up here before asking the founder.

New Instagram page about Indian startups for Indian Gen Z 21-30 with money to spend. All videos are motion graphics only (no filming, no clipping), voiced with ElevenLabs. Target: 6 startup videos and 3 Solids For You awareness videos a day. SFY main page comes later.

Draft strategy in social/strategy.md: motion-graphics videos built with the Master video workflow, one template per series, start at 3 a day and work up to 9, bio says who runs the page, every startup number sourced.
Get Solids For You product facts from the founder (products, prices, sizes, claims allowed) and add them here before writing any SFY reel.
Instagram API client code is in sfy_instagram/ (README.md explains it); merged into the review branch, which goes to main through one pull request.

Motion graphics style from founder's references (Drive folder 1euircKI12rys5i2cVhhleaOED1AuEsKt): dark near-black backgrounds with one glowing accent colour (teal, amber or purple), kinetic text that types in and highlights one key word, glass UI cards and app icons, glowing rings and light flares, clean sans-serif, logo reveal on a glowing horizon at the end. Fifth reference (Spotify-style, uploaded 2026-10-25): soft green glow on black, the brand's own UI pieces (track cards, filter chips, artist circles) as props, a short tagline split over two beats, logo reveal then handle card. Accent colour can follow the featured company's brand colour.
All voice-overs are in Hinglish, made with ElevenLabs by the founder in bulk: one batch of 18 voice-overs covers 2 days (12 startup + 6 SFY videos).
Some videos (Brand Autopsy and 30-Second Founder) use the heavy-animation style of the Spotify-style reference: very animated but beautiful. Others use simpler reusable templates.

Instagram page: Unicorn Ka Hisab, handle @unicornkahisab. Spelling is HISAB (one 'a') everywhere: name, logo, captions. Logo in brand/logo/ (ukh-icon, ukh-wordmark, ukh-stacked). Bio in English, in social/account-setup.md.

Meta app UKH Publisher set up for @unicornkahisab (tester accepted, publish and insights permissions ready). Keys are environment secrets IG_ACCESS_TOKEN, IG_APP_ID, IG_APP_SECRET, IG_REDIRECT_URI; never print them. Status and next steps in social/instagram-api.md.
Founder prefers horizontal (1920x1080) reels: the reels that match his taste are horizontal. Make new reels horizontal unless told otherwise.

Track is "addiction" by LONOWN and Asenssia (Spotify 57APJu1T2SP0JFR94PKDfu); credit it in captions. Post reels with the founder's chosen music even though it may be copyrighted; founder accepts the risk and removes muted reels himself. Music should fade in or use a riser so it never feels like it starts mid-song.

After the 9 reels of 26 Oct 2026 post, review Instagram insights with the founder (views, watch time, follows), compare vertical Blinkit vs horizontal reels and morning vs evening slots. Founder loved the reels' style.
Founder wants camera movements in reels: 3D push-ins, pans, tilts, orbits per scene and whip-pans on cuts (built into videos/template/reel.html).

Real SFY fabric and workshop footage (10 photos + 18 clips: cutting, stitching, SOLIDS label sheets, heat press, label reveal, drawstrings; blue tees and black joggers) is in Drive folder 1Q3kI0Qqr9yB1W7WPbjOVxVOd-n8cEe8Y; photos in videos/sfy/img, clip cut list in videos/sfy/edit.js (extract.py makes frames). SFY edit: videos/sfy/scene.html (photo-only first version: photos.html) -> public/reels/sfy-fabric-30s.mp4 (no product claims, since SFY facts are still missing).

Use Openverse only for real-life stock photos (videos/stock.py, no key; commercial + modification licences only). Credit the creator in the caption when credits.json says credit_required. Pixabay is set up in the script but not in use.

Reels are hosted from the public repo via raw.githubusercontent.com/solidsforyou/moneymoments-media/<branch>/public/reels/<file>.mp4 (push first). The container proxy blocks that host for curl, but Instagram fetches it fine. Captions must be set at container creation; the API cannot add them later.

No @mentions of brands or @solidsforyou in startup captions: name companies in plain text. Editing a caption with mentions hit Instagram's feedback_required block on 27 Oct (new account, spam signal). Account Status was clear.

Make reels trend-led: tie each one to what Indian startup news is discussing that week (share moves, results, controversies) so it earns likes and shares. Indian D2C brands' current troubles are an approved topic. Run harsh-buyer-review before posting.

Daily mix, 4 reels: 1 Startup ka Hisab (one company's numbers), 1 D2C market news (the sector, not one brand), and 2 Indian economy news reels, one of which can sometimes be a finance tip tied to the news (educational, not personal advice). No international news. No brand-specific D2C reels for now.

Signature for every reel (from founder's reference Video-20093, 27 Oct): one continuous Hisab line (the money trend, amber, never cuts, morphs between scenes) and one amber ₹ coin riding it, landing at the start and rolling into the end card. Built in videos/d2c/scene.html; reuse it. On-screen text mostly English. Use Solids For You footage (assets/sfy/) for positive moments, labelled on screen. Founder loved the D2C reel built this way (27 Oct): treat it as the benchmark.

SFY footage library in git: assets/sfy/clips (label-closeup, stitching-hands, sewing-machine, heat-press-vertical) and assets/sfy/photos (blue tees, black joggers); README there. Originals stay in Drive folder 1Q3kI0Qqr9yB1W7WPbjOVxVOd-n8cEe8Y.
Read every message in full, including every attachment (all photos, videos), and act on all of it; messages sent while a task is running are live instructions to pick up immediately.

Camera rule (founder, 27 Oct): every reel is one continuous camera move. The coin drops in on the first frame; to go to the next screen the coin rolls to the centre and the camera moves right with it into the next panel. The camera never stops and never cuts. Engine: videos/lib/hisab.js (panels side by side in one world).

Reel length: as long as the story needs, no fixed duration; shorter or longer than 60 s is fine (founder, 27 Oct, replaces the ~60 s rule). Pace panels so a viewer can read each one; explain, don't flash numbers. Watch time is not the goal. Set panel lengths from the content first, then fit the music (trim with fade-out or extend), not 12 panels forced onto the 60 s mix. The 27 Oct reels stay as they are.
Less text, more visuals, always (founder, 27 Oct): every word on screen gets a meaningful visual (icon, object, diagram) in the same frame. Short labels, not sentences. Icon set: videos/lib/icons.js.

Founder loved the visual-first reels with the continuous coin camera (27 Oct): D2C, inflation, EMI tip, Swiggy are the style benchmark (not for length, see #26). Approved slots that day: Swiggy 5 pm, D2C 3 pm, inflation 7 pm, EMI tip 9 pm IST.

Captions dropped on API posts after the 26 Oct action block (boAt, Urban Company, D2C, Swiggy, inflation on 27 Oct), pre-made container or not. EMI tip at 9 pm IST 27 Oct (created and published in one go) kept its caption, so the issue may be clearing. Cause unconfirmed. Check every post's caption right after publishing; if missing, give the founder the text to paste.
Anything for print (checklists, box labels, shipment sheets) is black and white only: pure black on white, no greys or colour (founder, 27 Oct). Black logo: assets/brand/sfy-logo-black.png.

27 Oct: founder packing the first FBA shipment by hand. Drive folder 1Bg4KdV6AJ0dIEcHVh8BtqkgbsyjCP6zK is public: list via drive.google.com/embeddedfolderview?id=..., download via drive.usercontent.google.com/download?id=...&export=download&confirm=t (MCP caps at 10 MB). Trim clips into shipment-day/clips (index in its README), then make a time-lapse of him showing and packing every product.

SFY full inventory per the factory (Manoj Sharma, Ganpati Prints, 7 Oct 2026): Men's fitted tee 33, oversized tee 33, white joggers 15, black joggers 21; Women's fitted tee 33, oversized tee 24, white joggers 18, black joggers 15. Total 192.
